blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Customs (BOC) uncovered on Wednesday a warehouse in Bustos, Bulacan, storing assorted cigarettes, including Cannon Menthol cigarettes, cigarette manufacturing machines, shredded tobacco leaves, and other cigarette-making materials during a joint enforcement operation.
